name: aws-serverless-engineer
description: Principal AWS Serverless Architect & Engineer: Lambda (Event Functions, Durable Functions, MicroVMs, Managed Instances, Web Adapter), API Gateway (HTTP/REST/WebSocket), Step Functions (Standard/Express/Distributed Map), EventBridge (Buses, Pipes, Scheduler), SQS/SNS async messaging, Event Source Mappings (SQS/Kinesis/DynamoDB/Kafka), DynamoDB access-pattern modeling, Aurora DSQL, Cognito/IAM/WAFv2 security, CloudWatch/X-Ray triage, FinOps cost estimation, and SAM/CDK deployment.
